WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.category, p.subcategory, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.category, p.subcategory, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN n.store_id=900 THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END) web, SUM(CASE WHEN n.subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END) outdoor
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE n.category='Garden' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT 'prod' t, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) k FROM dim_product UNION ALL SELECT 'store', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT store_key) FROM dim_store
UNION ALL SELECT 'prod_overlap', COUNT(*), 0 FROM dim_product a JOIN dim_product b ON a.sku=b.sku AND a.product_key<b.product_key AND a.valid_from<=b.valid_to AND b.valid_from<=a.valid_to
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_nomatch_prod', COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.product_key IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_nomatch_store', COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store p ON p.store_key=f.store_key WHERE p.store_key IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_outside_validity', COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE n.category='Garden' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2
